description: File extension must be csv xls xlsx
File must not be empty
File must be readable
File must have valid encoding
Excel files must not be password protected
File must not be corrupted
All required columns must be present
Duplicate column names are not allowed
Unnamed columns must be flagged
Numeric columns must contain valid numbers
Date columns must contain valid dates
Categorical columns must be non-empty strings
Boolean columns must be valid booleans
Missing values must be reported
Blank strings must be reported
Duplicate records must be detected
Duplicate primary identifiers must be detected
Invalid categories must be flagged
Extreme values must be flagged
Invalid dates must be flagged
Future dates beyond configured range must be flagged
Staff IDs must exist in Staff Roster
Department must exist in department reference
Hospital must exist in hospital reference
KPI IDs must exist in governed KPI catalogue
Scenario family must exist in governed scenario catalogue
Date range must be within configured analysis window
Invalid date sequences must be flagged
Duplicate reporting periods must be flagged
Gaps in expected dates must be flagged
Dataset must not contain unexpected sensitive columns
Schema changes must be approved
Unsupported identifier formats must be flagged
Negative beds check not applicable for this dataset
beds_total must be >= 0
beds_occupied must be >= 0
beds_occupied must not exceed beds_total
arrivals must be >= 0
avg_wait_min must be >= 0
n_responses must be >= 0
satisfaction_score must remain within governed scale
severity must map to governed categories
complaint dates must be valid
